title: Long compatibility planning lost its empty performance output directory

reproduction.observed: The immutable calibration passed every static TaskNode, all 113 exact Factorio environments, upgrade, ecosystem, approved delta, Base performance, and Space Age performance. The first measured medium-ecosystem baseline then failed because the 154-character compatibility lock path's parent output directory was absent.
reproduction.error: Could not find a part of the path compat/compat-candidates.lock.json.
reproduction.distinction: This was not the earlier Factorio 263-character stage-discovery failure. Both medium-ecosystem warmups succeeded below the 240-character compact-root budget, and their raw artifacts were preserved.

root_cause.summary: Invoke-MIRCompatAudit materialized an empty output directory before a long dependency-resolution phase and later wrote governed artifacts through the stale resolved path without revalidating the directory. The directory was absent at the first lock write. Historical-source performance overlays also lacked an exact controller copy of the repaired compatibility audit, so editing only the current checkout would not repair C24 calibration.

regression_propositions: compatibility audit resolves its requested output path early but materializes and revalidates the directory immediately before governed artifact emission
the C24 performance overlay contains the exact controller compatibility-audit bytes and binds their SHA-256 in its immutable manifest and harness fingerprint
the compact-path admission calculation covers both exact-package and compatibility-audit runners
raw artifacts from the failed immutable context remain retained and are never converted into passing evidence
a new immutable C24 context is required after the committed repair
C24, P9, and C30 package bytes remain unchanged

closure.proof_required: one complete fresh C24 calibration and compact proof under a committed controller containing the late-materialization and exact-overlay repair
